title: Fireworks Noise Peak by Hour
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fireworks:noise
| search db_peak=*
| bin _time span=1h
| stats max(db_peak) as db_peak avg(db_avg) as db_avg by _time zone_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks fireworks noise peaks over time and breaks it out by zone.
value: Peak noise by hour shows when the disruption window really sits instead of relying on memory or annoyance.
implementation: Send fireworks noise peaks events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1h granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of fireworks noise peaks by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how fireworks noise peaks changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
